propositions: A plan edited mid-review continues running all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time, wasting compute on invalidated checkpoints keyed by material fingerprint
Cancelled review verdict must be scoped to own material only (not relation snapshot or tracker HEAD) to avoid reintroducing false cancels on unrelated ticket writes
Cancel probe must be placed at exactly two between-pass seams (after finders and after decide) before the coach/verify recovery paths that would emit signatures and sidecar writes
Cancelled review returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale before reaching attest.sign_plan_review or sidecar.emit, preserving monotone safety
The cancel detection reads only the single ticket's current material fingerprint under local_read_context without fetching, reconverging, or acquiring sync locks
In-flight _chunk calls are guarded by a ContextVar-scoped event that can be set after an intermediate seam detects own_material_changed, short-circuiting runner invocations
